sections.content: You know the structures of the whole B1 course: narration (B1 Unit 1), opinion and doubt (B1 Units 13 and 25), cause and consequence (A2 Unit 5), recommendation, *si* clauses (B1 Unit 4) and past hypotheticals with *hubiera* (B1 Unit 35). Here you retrieve them together in connected communication.

items.spanish: Si hubiera tenido más información, habría tomado otra decisión.
items.english: If I had had more information, I would have made a different decision.

items.spanish: Es importante que expliquemos las consecuencias antes de decidir.
items.english: It is important that we explain the consequences before deciding.

items.spanish: Cuando reflexiono sobre mi progreso, veo que ya puedo narrar, opinar y hablar de posibilidades con confianza.
items.english: When I reflect on my progress, I see that I can already narrate, give opinions and talk about possibilities with confidence.

sections.content: If one thing deserves a second look, it is the indicative or subjunctive choice: nearly every structure in this unit depends on whether you state a fact or something uncertain, evaluated or unreal.
